text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Even though the winter event is 
starting soon... Why... Why...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The manuscript is completely blank...!! If 
I don't submit it in four days, the early 
bird... the early bird discount will be 
gone!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Has Digi-tan dried up...? My love 
for Umamusume is overflowing, yet... my 
hand... won't hold the pen...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... As expected, for this year, I'll 
just stick to back issues and a flyer—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian, are you eating properly? Listen, 
you need the right nutrition to match your 
training—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, sis, after school 
today... I hope you haven't forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, changing the subject, are we? 
What a hopeless little sister. But—yes, I 
remember.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Let's settle this, Sis. With both of 
us... running at our absolute best."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Phew... I see, that makes sense!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature, Nature! Guess what, guess what! 
Turbo, right—!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah, calm down— I'm listening, 
alright?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo wants that nikujaga Nature made 
before! It was super-duper delicious!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature, you're so good at cooking! Just 
like a real chef!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you're laying it on way too thick.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Guess I've got no choice. Nature-san is 
just weak to Turbo's begging, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ngghhh...!! I, get, it, nooowww!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So many Umamusume cuties... So much 
light... so much love...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I know... I know. There's nothing we can 
do, right? Hey, Digi-tan...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah... I can't take this anymore...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...A new doujin... gotta make it...
